NOT_SUITABLE.title: Record this case as not clinically suitable?

CLAIM_CASE.title: This case has no coordinator
CLAIM_CASE.body: Review the intake details, then take ownership to start work.

VIEW_ONLY.title: Owned by another coordinator
VIEW_ONLY.body: You have view-only access to this case.

VIEW_ONLY_STAFF.title: The case coordinator owns this case
VIEW_ONLY_STAFF.body: You can review it; the coordinator handles its workflow.

ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT.title: New assignment
ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT.body: Review the case, then accept the assignment or decline so the coordinator can reassign it.

ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT_DOCTOR.title: New clinical assignment
ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT_DOCTOR.body: Review the case summary and documents, then accept to begin your clinical review — or decline so the coordinator can reassign it.

WAIT_PATIENT_INFORMATION.title: Waiting for the patient's information
WAIT_PATIENT_INFORMATION.body: Nothing is needed from you right now. If their reply arrives by WhatsApp or phone, record it from More actions.

WAIT_CONSULTANT.title: Waiting for the Consultant
WAIT_CONSULTANT.body: The case returns to you as soon as the clinical recommendation is recorded.

WAIT_PATIENT_DECISION.title: With the patient
WAIT_PATIENT_DECISION.body: The proposal was delivered. The case returns to you when they decide.

WAIT_PAYMENT.title: Waiting for the coordination deposit
WAIT_PAYMENT.body: Finance records the receipt; the journey continues automatically once it is confirmed.

WAIT_OPERATIONS.title: Operations is arranging travel and arrival
WAIT_OPERATIONS.body: The case continues once the arrangements are confirmed.

ASSIGN_CONSULTANT.title: Prepare the case for a Consultant
ASSIGN_CONSULTANT.body: Complete anything missing, then assign a Consultant for this care area.

PREPARE_PROPOSAL.title: Prepare the patient proposal
PREPARE_PROPOSAL.body: Review the approved recommendation and internal requirements before releasing it.

RELEASE_PROPOSAL.title: Release the proposal to the patient
RELEASE_PROPOSAL.body: Check the release requirements, then release the secure link.

ASSIGN_OPERATIONS.title: Start treatment coordination
ASSIGN_OPERATIONS.body: The deposit is settled. Assign Operations to arrange travel and arrival.

ASSIGN_OPERATIONS_PLAN.title: Plan the travel package with Operations
ASSIGN_OPERATIONS_PLAN.body: The patient asked for a travel package. Assign Operations to plan and price it before the proposal is released.

PREPARE_TRAVEL_PACKAGE.title: Plan the travel package
PREPARE_TRAVEL_PACKAGE.body: Describe the travel package for the proposal before it is released. Bookings and arrival are arranged only after the patient's deposit.

ASSIGN_FINANCE.title: Finance must approve the commercial terms
ASSIGN_FINANCE.body: A manually priced service needs Finance sign-off before release. Assign who should approve it.

WAIT_INTERNAL_APPROVAL.title: Waiting for internal sign-off
WAIT_INTERNAL_APPROVAL.body: The assigned team completes their part; release unlocks once every requirement is met.

RECORD_FINAL_ASSESSMENT.title: Record your final assessment
RECORD_FINAL_ASSESSMENT.body: You have examined the patient: confirm or change your recommendation and its estimate lines.

RECORD_CLINICAL_DECISION.title: Record your clinical decision
RECORD_CLINICAL_DECISION.body: Review the intake summary and documents, then record your recommendation.

RESERVE_HOSPITAL.title: Reserve the hospital
RESERVE_HOSPITAL.body: Reserve the hospital and the planned admission date with the facility.

RECORD_ADMISSION_LETTER.title: Record the admission letter
RECORD_ADMISSION_LETTER.body: Record the hospital's admission letter with its quoted package price, so Finance can check it.

UPDATE_TRAVEL_PLAN.title: Arrange travel and arrival
UPDATE_TRAVEL_PLAN.body: Keep the travel plan current; confirm it once every requirement is met.

APPROVE_COMMERCIAL_TERMS.title: Approve the commercial terms
APPROVE_COMMERCIAL_TERMS.body: Review the manually priced services before the proposal can be released.

default.title: Nothing needs you right now
default.body: The next step appears here as soon as it is due.

RECORD_FEE_BALANCE.title: Record the platform fee balance
RECORD_FEE_BALANCE.body: The deposit did not cover the platform fee. Record the balance the patient paid, with its reference.

RECORD_E_INVOICE.title: Record the e-invoice reference
RECORD_E_INVOICE.body: The statement is issued. Record the tax authority's document id for it; it can be recorded once.

RECORD_HOSPITAL_BALANCE.title: Record the hospital receipt
RECORD_HOSPITAL_BALANCE.body: The patient pays the balance at the hospital cashier against the voucher. Record the receipt; Finance then countersigns it.

RECORD_ADMISSION_NUMBER.title: Record the admission number
RECORD_ADMISSION_NUMBER.body: The patient is cleared for admission. Record the hospital's admission number once it is issued; treatment cannot start without it.

RECORD_MILESTONE.title: Record the next treatment milestone
RECORD_MILESTONE.body: The patient is in treatment. Record each milestone as it happens: the patient reads a calm line for each one, and the next is due within 24 working hours.

COMPLETE_DISCHARGE_PACK.title: Complete the discharge pack
COMPLETE_DISCHARGE_PACK.body: Discharge is planned. Record the pack documents and the follow-up plan under Discharge; the patient is discharged once nothing blocks it.

RECORD_FINAL_INVOICE.title: Record the hospital's final invoice
RECORD_FINAL_INVOICE.body: Discharge is planned. Record the final invoice once the hospital issues it; discharge waits for it.

CONFIRM_RETURN.title: Confirm the return
CONFIRM_RETURN.body: Confirm how and when the patient travels home. A flight needs a valid fit to fly.

CONFIRM_DEPARTURE.title: Confirm the departure
CONFIRM_DEPARTURE.body: The return is confirmed. Confirm once the patient has left.

CONTACT_NOT_VERIFIED.title: Waiting for contact verification
CONTACT_NOT_VERIFIED.body: The patient verifies their contact channel through the secure link. The coordination deposit is paid once that is done.

CONSENTS_INCOMPLETE.title: Waiting for the patient's consents
CONSENTS_INCOMPLETE.body: Required consents are captured through the secure profile link.

ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE.title: Waiting for the patient to submit onboarding
ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE.body: The patient reviews and submits their onboarding through the secure link.

REPRESENTATIVE_AUTH_MISSING.title: Waiting for representative authorization
REPRESENTATIVE_AUTH_MISSING.body: A valid representative authorization is required before coordination continues.

MINOR_REQUIRES_GUARDIAN.title: Waiting for a parent or legal guardian
MINOR_REQUIRES_GUARDIAN.body: The patient is under 18. A parent or legal guardian confirms they act for the patient from My Care.

GUARDIAN_AUTH_MISSING.title: Waiting for the guardian's details
GUARDIAN_AUTH_MISSING.body: The guardian says how they are related to the patient and gives their consent from My Care.

GUARDIAN_EVIDENCE_MISSING.title: Waiting for the guardian's document
GUARDIAN_EVIDENCE_MISSING.body: The guardian chooses the document that shows their authority. Without one on the case, send them a secure upload link.

GUARDIAN_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED.title: The guardian's document needs your check
GUARDIAN_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED.body: Open Age and guardian on the case, look at the document, then verify or refuse it.

DEPOSIT_UNPAID.title: Waiting for the patient's deposit transfer
DEPOSIT_UNPAID.body: The patient pays by bank transfer and enters the bank's transaction reference on their case page. Finance then verifies it.

default.title: Waiting for the patient to activate their profile
default.body: The secure profile link was sent to the patient. The coordination deposit is arranged once the profile is active.

myWork.title: My work
myWork.hint: Work assigned to you personally, most urgent first.
myWork.hintTeam: Work for you or your team, most urgent first.
myWork.emptyHint: Anything assigned to you shows up here.

queue.unownedHint: New requests nobody owns yet. Taking ownership makes you the case owner.
queue.teamHint: Cases owned by coordinators on your team. Transfer ownership to rebalance work.
queue.mineHint: Cases you own as the responsible coordinator.
queue.assignedHintFinance: Cases you are on, or with a deposit to record.
queue.search: Search case number, name or care area
queue.emptyHint: Cases appear here when they become available to you.
queue.bulkClaimResult: Took ownership of {done} of {total} cases. The others could not be claimed — another coordinator may have taken them — and stay selected.
queue.bulkRequestResult: Sent to {done} of {total} cases. The others were not sent and stay selected; sending again retries only those.
queue.requestFailed: The request was not sent. Nothing has changed; try again.
queue.unownedInQueue: No coordinator yet — in the team queue

summary.title: At a glance
summary.hint: Select a count to show only those cases. Select it again to show every case.
summary.nothing: No cases need action right now.

step.noAction: No action is required from you right now.

withdraw.title: Withdraw from this journey?
withdraw.body: Your case will be closed and our team will stop arranging your treatment. Your coordinator remains available if you would like to start again later.

emergency.title: If this is an emergency, seek local care now
emergency.body: Your care team does not monitor messages around the clock. Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department.

PROVIDE_INFORMATION.title: We need something from you
PROVIDE_INFORMATION.body: Your coordinator has asked for information or a document so your case can continue.
PROVIDE_INFORMATION.next: Reply here, or use the secure link we sent you to upload documents. Your coordinator then reviews it and continues.

REVIEW_PROPOSAL.title: Your estimate is ready to review
REVIEW_PROPOSAL.body: Your treatment plan and its estimated cost are ready. Take the time you need — nothing happens until you decide.
REVIEW_PROPOSAL.next: Once you acknowledge it, your next step appears here in My Care.

REVIEW_FINAL_QUOTE.title: Your final quote is ready to review
REVIEW_FINAL_QUOTE.body: Your final quote is ready. Take the time you need — nothing happens until you decide.
REVIEW_FINAL_QUOTE.next: If you accept it, your coordinator confirms your schedule and arrangements.

COMPLETE_PROFILE.title: A few details are still needed
COMPLETE_PROFILE.body: Before we can arrange your care, the steps below need to be completed. Use the secure link we sent you, or message your coordinator.
COMPLETE_PROFILE.next: Once they are done, your coordinator continues.

VERIFY_IDENTITY.title: Identity verification
VERIFY_IDENTITY.body: Because travel support is part of your care, we need to verify your identity before arrangements are confirmed. Only the minimum is stored, encrypted.
VERIFY_IDENTITY.next: Our team reviews it and your coordinator continues.

WAIT_CASE_RECEIVED.title: We have your case
WAIT_CASE_RECEIVED.body: Your case has been received and is waiting for a coordinator to look at it.
WAIT_CASE_RECEIVED.next: A coordinator will check what you sent and tell you if anything is missing.
WAIT_CASE_RECEIVED.meanwhile: Gather any recent reports, scans or prescriptions you have, in case your coordinator asks for them.

WAIT_COORDINATOR_REVIEW.title: Your coordinator is reviewing your case
WAIT_COORDINATOR_REVIEW.body: Your coordinator is going through what you sent and preparing it for a Consultant.
WAIT_COORDINATOR_REVIEW.next: Your case will be sent to a Consultant in the right specialty.
WAIT_COORDINATOR_REVIEW.meanwhile: Keep your recent reports to hand, and message your coordinator if anything about your condition changes.

WAIT_CONSULTANT_REVIEW.title: A Consultant is reviewing your case
WAIT_CONSULTANT_REVIEW.body: A Consultant is going through your reports and history now.
WAIT_CONSULTANT_REVIEW.next: You will receive a recommendation and an initial cost estimate.
WAIT_CONSULTANT_REVIEW.meanwhile: Keep following your own doctor's advice, and tell your coordinator if your symptoms change.

WAIT_PROPOSAL_REVISION.title: We are preparing a revised proposal
WAIT_PROPOSAL_REVISION.body: Your coordinator is updating the proposal with the changes you asked for.
WAIT_PROPOSAL_REVISION.next: You will receive a new secure link to review it.
WAIT_PROPOSAL_REVISION.meanwhile: Note any other questions about the plan or the cost, so your coordinator can answer them together.

WAIT_PROPOSAL_EXPIRED.title: We are preparing an updated proposal
WAIT_PROPOSAL_EXPIRED.body: Your previous estimate expired. Your coordinator is preparing an updated one.
WAIT_PROPOSAL_EXPIRED.next: You will receive a new secure link to review it.
WAIT_PROPOSAL_EXPIRED.meanwhile: Check that your passport is valid and think about who would travel with you.

WAIT_PROPOSAL.title: We are preparing your proposal
WAIT_PROPOSAL.body: Your coordinator is putting together the treatment plan and its estimated cost.
WAIT_PROPOSAL.next: You will receive the proposal to review in your own time.
WAIT_PROPOSAL.meanwhile: Check that your passport is valid and think about who would travel with you.

PAY_DEPOSIT.title: Pay your coordination deposit
PAY_DEPOSIT.body: Your profile is complete. Pay the deposit by bank transfer or through an agent, then enter the reference or receipt number you are given.
PAY_DEPOSIT.next: Once our Finance team confirms your payment, your coordinator starts arranging your treatment.

WAIT_PAYMENT_CHECK.title: We're checking your payment
WAIT_PAYMENT_CHECK.body: Thank you. Our Finance team is matching your payment with the number you sent, and we'll let you know as soon as it's confirmed.
WAIT_PAYMENT_CHECK.next: Once your payment is confirmed, your coordinator starts arranging your treatment.
WAIT_PAYMENT_CHECK.meanwhile: Keep your transfer or agent receipt. There is no need to pay again.

WAIT_COORDINATION.title: We are arranging your treatment
WAIT_COORDINATION.body: Your coordinator is organising your appointments and, where agreed, the practical side of your trip.
WAIT_COORDINATION.next: You will receive your dates and arrival details.
WAIT_COORDINATION.meanwhile: Keep your passport and phone to hand; your coordinator will message you with dates.

WAIT_TREATMENT.title: Your arrival is confirmed
WAIT_TREATMENT.body: Everything is set for your arrival.
WAIT_TREATMENT.meanwhile: Follow the arrival instructions you received and bring all your reports with you.

IN_TREATMENT.title: Your treatment is under way
IN_TREATMENT.body: Your care team is with you throughout your treatment.
IN_TREATMENT.next: After discharge we stay in contact for follow-up.

FOLLOW_UP.title: You are in follow-up
FOLLOW_UP.body: Your treatment is complete and we stay in contact while you recover.

DECLINED.title: You declined the proposal
DECLINED.body: Your case is closed for now. Your coordinator remains available if anything changes.

CLINICALLY_NOT_SUITABLE.title: This case is not clinically suitable for treatment with us
CLINICALLY_NOT_SUITABLE.body: The Consultant reviewed your case and advised against treatment here. Your coordinator can explain what this means.

WITHDRAWN.title: You withdrew from this journey
WITHDRAWN.body: Your case is closed at your request. Your coordinator remains available if you would like to start again.

CANCELLED.title: This case was cancelled
CANCELLED.body: Your journey with us has ended. Your coordinator can explain what this means and what happens next.

EXPIRED.title: This case has expired
EXPIRED.body: The coordination deposit was not received in time, so your case is on hold. Your coordinator can reopen it with you if you would like to continue.

COMPLETED.title: Your care with us is complete
COMPLETED.body: Your treatment and its follow-up are complete. If anything changes, contact your coordinator.

CLOSED.title: This case is closed
CLOSED.body: If you would like to look at your options again, contact your coordinator.

NONE.title: You're all set for now
NONE.body: Our team is handling the next step and will keep you updated.

CONFIRM_ARRIVAL.title: Tell us when you have arrived
CONFIRM_ARRIVAL.body: Once you are in Egypt, confirm your arrival here so your coordinator and the hospital can prepare your admission.
CONFIRM_ARRIVAL.next: You then pay the hospital balance at the cashier, using your admission voucher.

PAY_BALANCE.title: Pay the balance at the hospital
PAY_BALANCE.body: Show your voucher number at the hospital cashier and pay the amount below. Keep the receipt; the hospital sends us a copy.
PAY_BALANCE.next: Our Finance team checks the receipt, then you are cleared for admission.

WAIT_BALANCE_CHECK.title: We are checking your hospital receipt
WAIT_BALANCE_CHECK.body: The hospital's receipt for your balance is recorded. Our Finance team is checking it.
WAIT_BALANCE_CHECK.next: Once it is checked, you are cleared for admission.
WAIT_BALANCE_CHECK.meanwhile: Keep your receipt and your reports with you.

CLEARED_FOR_ADMISSION.title: You are cleared for admission
CLEARED_FOR_ADMISSION.body: Your balance is settled and everything is in place for your admission.
CLEARED_FOR_ADMISSION.next: The hospital admits you and your treatment begins as planned.
CLEARED_FOR_ADMISSION.meanwhile: Bring your passport, your voucher number and all your reports to the hospital.

REVIEW_CHANGE_ORDER.title: Review a change to your treatment
REVIEW_CHANGE_ORDER.body: Your Consultant recommends a change to your treatment that adds to its cost. Read why and what it costs, then accept or decline it.
REVIEW_CHANGE_ORDER.next: Your care team is told your decision straight away.

GOING_HOME.title: You are going home
GOING_HOME.body: You have been discharged. Below are the warning signs to watch for, your medicines, your follow-up and your documents.
GOING_HOME.next: Your coordinator stays in touch while you recover.

REPORT_OUTCOME.title: How are you doing?
REPORT_OUTCOME.body: Your care team asks a few short questions about your recovery. It takes about a minute.

satisfaction.label: How satisfied are you with your care?

complication.legend: Has anything gone wrong since you left hospital?
complication.whatHint: For example a fever, bleeding, a wound that opens or a new pain. Your Consultant reviews it.
complication.emergency: If it is an emergency, do not wait for a reply: call your local emergency number.

outcome.sent: Thank you. Your answers reached your care team.
outcome.sentComplication: Thank you. Your Consultant is asked to review what you reported, and your coordinator is told.

errors.failed: Your answers could not be sent. Try again.
errors.outdated: This page has changed. Reload it and answer again.
errors.session: Your session ended. Ask for a new code and try again.

outcome.received: Thank you. We received your answers on {date}.

closed.statementPending: Your closing statement is being prepared. We will tell you when it is ready.
closed.reviewBody: We sent you a message asking about your experience. If you would like to share it, reply to that message.

cancelCase.title: Cancel this case
cancelCase.hint: Ends the patient's journey. This cannot be undone.
cancelCase.noteHint: What the patient or hospital said. Kept with the case, encrypted.

urgency.title: Set the case urgency
urgency.moreHint: Your clinical judgement of how soon the case needs attention. Urgent raises its work and tells your lead.
urgency.hint: Staff see it; the patient does not. The patient is always told to seek local emergency care in an emergency.
urgency.label: Urgency

PRIORITY.label: Priority
PRIORITY.hint: Sooner than routine. Shown to the team; the work order does not change.

URGENT.label: Urgent
URGENT.hint: Time-critical. All work on the case becomes high priority and your lead is alerted.

urgency.reasonHint: What you saw that sets this urgency. Kept with the case, encrypted.
urgency.reasonRequired: Say why the case has this urgency.

recordDecision.title: Record the patient's decision
recordDecision.moreHint: After going through the terms with them in Arabic.
recordDecision.hint: After going through the terms with the patient in Arabic.
recordDecision.attestEstimate: I went through the coordination deposit, refund and cancellation terms in Arabic with the patient or their representative, who confirmed they understood them.
recordDecision.attestQuote: I went through the payment terms of this quote in Arabic with the patient or their representative, who confirmed they understood them.
recordDecision.attestRequired: Confirm that you went through the terms with the patient.
recordDecision.noRepresentative: Nobody is authorised to act for this patient yet, so only the patient can confirm.
recordDecision.whenInvalid: Enter when you spoke, no later than now.
recordDecision.noteRequired: Say what the patient wants changed.
recordDecision.provenance: This is recorded as the patient's decision, captured by you. The patient will see who recorded it and how.
recordDecision.failed: The decision was not recorded. Nothing has changed; try again.

financeApproval.intro: Check the prices and the margin, then approve.
financeApproval.introManualOne: 1 line is priced by the Consultant outside their approved list — check its price before you approve.
financeApproval.introManual: {count} lines are priced by the Consultant outside their approved list — check their prices before you approve.
financeApproval.caption: Proposal lines with the Consultant's base price and the patient's price
financeApproval.noPolicy: No margin policy applies to this care area — no margin is added.
financeApproval.rateLater: At today's rate; the rate is fixed when the proposal is sent to the patient.
financeApproval.approveBody: The coordinator can then send the proposal to the patient at these prices. You may be asked to sign in again.

depositTransfer.title: Patient’s payment
depositTransfer.waiting: Waiting for the patient to pay and enter the transfer reference.
depositTransfer.amountInvalid: Enter the amount received in figures, above zero and no more than the balance, for example 12,500.
depositTransfer.amountInvalidMax: Enter the amount received in figures, above zero and no more than the balance of {amount}.
depositTransfer.rejectReason: Why it can't be confirmed (shown to the patient)
depositTransfer.confirmBody: The amount is credited to the patient's deposit. You may be asked to sign in again.
depositTransfer.rejectTitle: Return the reference {reference} to the patient?
depositTransfer.rejectBody: The patient sees your reason and can enter a new reference.
depositTransfer.sendLinkHint: Sends the patient a link to their payment step: the account details and where to enter the transfer reference.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Press the key marked with the Latin letter shown, whatever your keyboard language. Shortcuts pause while you type in a field or while a dialog is open.
shortcuts.listHint: Up and down arrows move between rows.
shortcuts.listHintActions: Up and down arrows move between rows; Shift+Tab reaches this row's other actions.
shortcuts.offNote: Single-key shortcuts are off. Arrow keys and Enter in lists still work.
shortcuts.next: Open the next item in My work
shortcuts.switchHint: Turn them off if they get in the way of voice control or a screen reader. Arrow keys and Enter in lists keep working. Saved in this browser.

caseMessages.title: Secure messages
caseMessages.internalOnly: Internal: the patient does not see this conversation.
caseMessages.coverYou: You are covering for {owner} until {until}. Only you reply to this patient meanwhile.
caseMessages.coverOther: {cover} is covering for {owner} until {until} and is the only one replying to the patient. You can read the conversation.

attachments.CLEAN: Attachment saved to the case documents.
attachments.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This attachment type is not kept. Please send files as PDF, JPG or PNG.
attachments.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: This message type cannot be shown here.
attachments.TOO_LARGE: This file was too large to keep. Please send a smaller file.
attachments.EXPIRED: This attachment could not be retrieved. Please send it again.
attachments.UNAVAILABLE: This attachment could not be retrieved. Please send it again.
attachments.REJECTED: This attachment did not pass the security check and was not kept.
attachments.CASE_FILE_LIMIT: This file was not kept because the case has reached its file limit.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.intro: WhatsApp conversations with people who have not sent a case yet. Each has one coordinator; only they, or their cover, reply.

empty.mine: No conversations are waiting for you.
empty.queue: Nobody is waiting in the queue.
empty.team: Your team has no open conversations.

conversations.pick: Choose a conversation to read it.
conversations.windowClosed: WhatsApp’s 24-hour reply window has closed. You can send one follow-up asking them to reply.
conversations.readOnly: You can read this conversation; its coordinator replies.

leaveCase.title: Leave this case?
leaveCase.body: Text you typed in this case hasn’t been sent. If you leave now, it will be lost.

CASE_CANCELLED_NO_INFORMATION.title: The case was cancelled — the patient did not answer
CASE_CANCELLED_NO_INFORMATION.context: The information request went unanswered for {days} days. The patient was told they can send their case again.

INFO_REQUEST_CLOSED.title: An unanswered information request was closed
INFO_REQUEST_CLOSED.context: The patient did not answer within {days} days, so the request was withdrawn. The case continues without it.

INFO_REQUEST_UNANSWERED.title: The patient has not answered your information request
INFO_REQUEST_UNANSWERED.context: They were reminded twice. Contact them, or record what they sent another way; the request closes on day {days}.

NEW_ASSIGNMENT_CLINICAL.title: New clinical assignment
NEW_ASSIGNMENT_CLINICAL.context: You have been assigned case {caseNumber} for clinical review. Accept it to start, or decline so the coordinator can reassign.

NEW_ASSIGNMENT.title: New case assignment
NEW_ASSIGNMENT.context: You have been assigned case {caseNumber} for review. Accept it to start, or decline so the coordinator can reassign.

RECOMMENDATION_READY.title: Clinical recommendation ready — prepare the proposal
RECOMMENDATION_READY.context: {consultant} submitted a clinical recommendation and the recommended services. Review them and prepare the patient proposal.

SECOND_OPINION_REQUESTED.title: Second opinion requested — assign another Consultant
SECOND_OPINION_REQUESTED.context: {consultant} asked for a second opinion. Choose the additional Consultant.

CLINICALLY_UNSUITABLE.title: Case marked clinically unsuitable
CLINICALLY_UNSUITABLE.context: {consultant} assessed this case as not clinically suitable.

RETURNED_WITHOUT_RECOMMENDATION.title: Case returned without a clinical recommendation
RETURNED_WITHOUT_RECOMMENDATION.context: {consultant} returned the case without a recommendation.

CLINICAL_REVIEW_DUE.title: Review the case and give your clinical recommendation
CLINICAL_REVIEW_DUE.context: Review the intake summary and documents, then record your recommendation.

ASSIGNMENT_DECLINED.title: Assignment declined — reassign the case
ASSIGNMENT_DECLINED.context: {assignee} declined this assignment. Choose another Consultant.

ASSIGNMENT_OFFER_EXPIRED.title: Consultant offer expired — reassign the case
ASSIGNMENT_OFFER_EXPIRED.context: {assignee} did not answer the offer within {hours} working hours. Choose another consultant.

OFFER_EXPIRED_CONSULTANT.title: A clinical assignment offer expired
OFFER_EXPIRED_CONSULTANT.context: Case {caseNumber} was offered to you for {hours} working hours and has gone back to the coordinator.

PROPOSAL_CHANGES_REQUESTED.title: Patient asked for changes to the proposal
PROPOSAL_CHANGES_REQUESTED.context: The patient asked for changes before continuing.

REPLY_COVER_ASSIGNED.title: You are covering {owner}’s patient conversations
REPLY_COVER_ASSIGNED.context: Their cases appear in your case list while the cover lasts; only you can reply to their patients meanwhile.

REPLY_COVER_ENDED.title: Your patients’ conversations are back with you
REPLY_COVER_ENDED.context: {cover} can no longer cover you, so you answer your patients again.

INTAKE_CONVERSATION_ASSIGNED.title: New WhatsApp conversation
INTAKE_CONVERSATION_ASSIGNED.context: Someone without a case wrote on WhatsApp. Reply in Conversations.

INTAKE_MESSAGE.title: New WhatsApp message
INTAKE_MESSAGE.context: A person you are talking to wrote again on WhatsApp. Reply in Conversations.

REPLY_REMINDER.title: A patient is waiting for your reply
REPLY_REMINDER.context: Someone wrote and has not had an answer yet.

REPLY_ESCALATED.title: A patient has waited too long for a reply
REPLY_ESCALATED.context: {coordinator} has not answered yet. Cover or reassign the conversation.

PATIENT_WHATSAPP_MESSAGE.title: New WhatsApp message from the patient
PATIENT_WHATSAPP_MESSAGE.context: The patient wrote on WhatsApp. Reply in the case's secure messages.

PATIENT_RESPONDED.title: Review the information the patient provided

PROPOSAL_TERMS_CALL.title: Go through the proposal terms with the patient in Arabic
PROPOSAL_TERMS_CALL.context: The patient asked you to go through the proposal’s terms with them in Arabic and record their decision.

REFERRAL_TRANSFER_REQUESTED.title: Consultant transfer requested — confirm the handover
REFERRAL_TRANSFER_REQUESTED.context: {consultant} asked to transfer this case to another Consultant. Review the referral and choose an eligible Consultant, or decline it.

REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_REQUESTED.title: Second opinion requested — choose a Consultant
REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_REQUESTED.context: {consultant} asked for a second opinion. Review the referral and choose an eligible Consultant, or decline it.

REFERRAL_TRANSFER_OFFERED.title: Case transfer offered to you
REFERRAL_TRANSFER_OFFERED.context: Case {caseNumber} is offered to you as its new Consultant. Accept to start, or decline so the coordinator can choose someone else.

REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_OFFERED.title: Second opinion requested from you
REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_OFFERED.context: You are asked for a second opinion on case {caseNumber}. Accept to start, or decline so the coordinator can choose someone else.

REFERRAL_TRANSFER_DECLINED.title: Referral declined — choose another Consultant
REFERRAL_TRANSFER_DECLINED.context: {consultant} declined the transfer. Choose another eligible Consultant, or decline the referral.

REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_DECLINED.title: Referral declined — choose another Consultant
REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_DECLINED.context: {consultant} declined the second-opinion request. Choose another eligible Consultant, or decline the referral.

SECOND_OPINION_DUE.title: Give your second opinion
SECOND_OPINION_DUE.context: Review the case and submit your opinion. Your access ends when you submit it.

DEPOSIT_VERIFY_TRANSFER.title: Verify the transfer
DEPOSIT_VERIFY_TRANSFER.context: The patient entered the transaction reference of their bank transfer for the coordination deposit. Check the bank for it, then confirm the amount received or reject it with a reason.

DEPOSIT_TRANSFER_REPORTED.title: The patient sent their transfer reference
DEPOSIT_TRANSFER_REPORTED.context: Finance is verifying the transfer for the coordination deposit.

DEPOSIT_REFERENCE_OVERDUE.title: No transfer reference yet — follow up with the patient
DEPOSIT_REFERENCE_OVERDUE.context: The patient was reminded for three days and has not entered the bank transfer reference for the coordination deposit. Contact them, and send the payment link if they need it.

CASE_EXPIRED_UNPAID.title: The case expired — the deposit was not paid
CASE_EXPIRED_UNPAID.context: The patient was reminded, you were alerted, and the grace period passed without a transfer reference. The case is expired; re-prepare the estimate if the patient comes back.

CASE_MARKED_URGENT.title: Case {caseNumber} was marked urgent
CASE_MARKED_URGENT.context: Its coordinator judged it time-critical. Make room for its work today.

DOCUMENT_CLEARED.title: A file on case {caseNumber} passed the virus check
DOCUMENT_CLEARED.context: It was uploaded while the check was unavailable and is now on the case. Tell the patient it arrived; a guardian can now choose it as evidence.

INCIDENT_REVIEW.title: Review an incident on case {caseNumber}
INCIDENT_REVIEW.context: Open the incident, take it up and resolve it with a note.

INCIDENT_CRITICAL.title: A critical incident was raised on case {caseNumber}
INCIDENT_CRITICAL.context: Another manager owns it. Open the incident list to see who.

INCIDENT_CLINICAL.title: A clinical incident was recorded on case {caseNumber}
INCIDENT_CLINICAL.context: Open the case to see its follow-up.

CASE_REOPENED.title: Case {caseNumber} was reopened
CASE_REOPENED.context: Its Consultant has been asked to review it.

FOLLOW_UP_REVIEW.title: Review the reopened case {caseNumber}
FOLLOW_UP_REVIEW.context: The case was reopened. Review it and plan the follow-up.

ASSIGN_CONSULTANT.title: Prepare the case for a Consultant
ASSIGN_CONSULTANT.context: Complete anything missing, then assign a Consultant for this care area.

ASSIGN_OPERATIONS_PLAN.title: Plan the travel package with Operations
ASSIGN_OPERATIONS_PLAN.context: The patient asked for a travel package. Assign Operations to plan and price it before the proposal is released.

ASSIGN_FINANCE.title: Finance must approve the commercial terms
ASSIGN_FINANCE.context: A manually priced service needs Finance sign-off before release. Assign who should approve it.

RECORD_FINAL_ASSESSMENT.title: Record the final assessment
RECORD_FINAL_ASSESSMENT.context: The patient has arrived. Examine them, then confirm or change your recommendation and its estimate lines.

RECORD_FEE_BALANCE.title: Record the platform fee balance
RECORD_FEE_BALANCE.context: The deposit did not cover the platform fee. Record the balance the patient paid, with its reference.

RECORD_E_INVOICE.title: Record the e-invoice reference
RECORD_E_INVOICE.context: The statement is issued. Record the tax authority's document id for it; it can be recorded once.

RELEASE_PROPOSAL.title: Release the proposal to the patient
RELEASE_PROPOSAL.context: Check the release requirements, then release the secure link.

APPROVE_COMMERCIAL_TERMS.title: Approve the commercial terms
APPROVE_COMMERCIAL_TERMS.context: Review the manually priced services before the proposal can be released.

PREPARE_TRAVEL_PACKAGE.title: Plan the travel package
PREPARE_TRAVEL_PACKAGE.context: Describe the travel package for the proposal before it is released. Bookings and arrival are arranged only after the patient's deposit.

RESERVE_HOSPITAL.title: Reserve the hospital
RESERVE_HOSPITAL.context: Reserve the hospital and the planned admission date with the facility.

RECORD_ADMISSION_LETTER.title: Record the admission letter
RECORD_ADMISSION_LETTER.context: Record the hospital's admission letter with its quoted package price, so Finance can check it.

UPDATE_TRAVEL_PLAN.title: Arrange travel and arrival
UPDATE_TRAVEL_PLAN.context: Keep the travel plan current; confirm it once every requirement is met.

TREATMENT_COORDINATION_START.title: Start treatment coordination — deposit received
TREATMENT_COORDINATION_START.context: The coordination deposit is confirmed. Begin the treatment journey for this case.

CASE_OWNERSHIP_TRANSFERRED.title: A case has been transferred to you
CASE_OWNERSHIP_TRANSFERRED.context: You are now the owner of case {caseNumber}. Open coordinator work on the case is now yours; the reason is in the assignment history.

SECOND_OPINION_RECEIVED_REFERRER.title: Second opinion received
SECOND_OPINION_RECEIVED_REFERRER.context: {consultant} submitted the second opinion you asked for.

SECOND_OPINION_RECEIVED_COORDINATOR.title: Second opinion received
SECOND_OPINION_RECEIVED_COORDINATOR.context: {consultant} submitted a second opinion on this case.

REFERRAL_TRANSFER_NOT_CONFIRMED.title: Your referral was not confirmed
REFERRAL_TRANSFER_NOT_CONFIRMED.context: The coordinator did not confirm your transfer.

REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_NOT_CONFIRMED.title: Your referral was not confirmed
REFERRAL_SECOND_OPINION_NOT_CONFIRMED.context: The coordinator did not confirm your second-opinion request.

TRANSFER_COMPLETED_REFERRER.title: Case transferred
TRANSFER_COMPLETED_REFERRER.context: {consultant} accepted the transfer. Your assignment on this case has ended.

CONSULTANT_NEEDS_INFORMATION.title: The Consultant needs more information from the patient
CONSULTANT_NEEDS_INFORMATION.context: {consultant} asked for more information before recommending.

CHECK_PROFORMA.title: Check the hospital's admission letter for {caseNumber}
CHECK_PROFORMA.context: Compare the hospital's quoted package with the accepted estimate, then accept or refuse the letter.

PRICE_VARIANCE.title: Hospital price above the estimate on {caseNumber}
PRICE_VARIANCE.context: The hospital quoted more than the estimate the patient accepted. Accept it with a reason or refuse it; travel cannot be confirmed until you decide.

REVISE_ADMISSION_LETTER.title: Finance refused the admission letter for {caseNumber}
REVISE_ADMISSION_LETTER.context: Ask the hospital for a new letter, then record it under Admission & money.

COUNTERSIGN_BALANCE.title: Countersign the hospital receipt for {caseNumber}
COUNTERSIGN_BALANCE.context: Operations recorded the cashier's receipt for the hospital balance. Check it against the voucher, then countersign it.

APPROVE_POINT_OF_NO_RETURN.title: Approve the point of no return for {caseNumber}
APPROVE_POINT_OF_NO_RETURN.context: Operations set the time after which travel is no longer refundable. Check it, then approve it.

EMERGENCY_ADMISSION_REVIEW.title: Review the emergency admission on {caseNumber}
EMERGENCY_ADMISSION_REVIEW.context: The Consultant admitted the patient before the balance was evidenced. Settle the money with Operations and the hospital.

ADMISSION_VOUCHER_BLOCKED.title: The admission voucher for {caseNumber} could not be issued
ADMISSION_VOUCHER_BLOCKED.context: The deposit is larger than the hospital package and the platform fee together, so no voucher was issued. The patient's acceptance stands; agree the next step with Operations.

CLEARED_FOR_ADMISSION.title: {caseNumber} is cleared for admission
CLEARED_FOR_ADMISSION.context: The final quote, the consent and the balance are evidenced. The hospital can admit the patient; record the admission number once it is issued.

RECORD_MILESTONE.title: Record the next milestone for {caseNumber}
RECORD_MILESTONE.context: A milestone is due within 24 working hours of the last one. Record what has happened under Treatment.

COUNTERSIGN_MILESTONE.title: Countersign a milestone on {caseNumber}
COUNTERSIGN_MILESTONE.context: Operations recorded a milestone on your behalf. Check it, then countersign it; until then the patient reads it as reported by the care team.

PRICE_CHANGE_ORDER.title: Price the change order on {caseNumber}
PRICE_CHANGE_ORDER.context: The Consultant proposed a change order. Price every line in EGP: within the band it is accepted, above it the patient decides.

EMERGENCY_CHANGE_ORDER_REVIEW.title: Review the emergency change order on {caseNumber}
EMERGENCY_CHANGE_ORDER_REVIEW.context: The Consultant made a change that could not wait. Price its lines and review it; the patient has been told.

CHANGE_ORDER_PATIENT_DECISION.title: Change order on {caseNumber} awaits the patient
CHANGE_ORDER_PATIENT_DECISION.context: A priced change order is above the band. Make sure the patient has seen it in My Care or on their secure link and can decide.

COUNTERSIGN_INTERIM_BILL.title: Countersign the interim bill on {caseNumber}
COUNTERSIGN_INTERIM_BILL.context: Operations recorded the hospital's interim bill. Check it against the hospital's statement, then countersign it.

CHANGE_ORDER_ACCEPTED.title: The patient accepted the change order on {caseNumber}
CHANGE_ORDER_ACCEPTED.context: The change is authorised and the running money includes it. The care team can go ahead.

CHANGE_ORDER_REJECTED.title: The patient declined the change order on {caseNumber}
CHANGE_ORDER_REJECTED.context: Do not go ahead with the change. The Consultant and the coordinator agree the next step with the patient.

TREATMENT_COMPLICATION.title: Complication recorded on {caseNumber}
TREATMENT_COMPLICATION.context: The Consultant recorded a complication and an incident is open for review. The patient reads a care update only.

DISCHARGE_PACK.title: Complete the discharge pack for {caseNumber}
DISCHARGE_PACK.context: Discharge is planned. Record the discharge summary, the medication list and the other pack documents, and the follow-up plan, by 18:00 Cairo time on the day.

RECORD_FINAL_INVOICE.title: Record the final invoice for {caseNumber}
RECORD_FINAL_INVOICE.context: Discharge is planned. Record the hospital's final invoice with its document by 18:00 Cairo time on the day; discharge waits for it.

RECONCILE_INVOICE.title: Reconcile the final invoice for {caseNumber}
RECONCILE_INVOICE.context: Operations recorded the hospital's final invoice. Open the reconciliation, match each line against what was authorised and submit it.

COUNTERSIGN_RECONCILIATION.title: Countersign the reconciliation for {caseNumber}
COUNTERSIGN_RECONCILIATION.context: The variance is above the band. Approve it, or return it to Finance with what to correct.

FACILITY_DISPUTE.title: Settle the disputed charge on {caseNumber}
FACILITY_DISPUTE.context: The hospital billed something that was not charged to the patient. Settle it with the hospital and record how it ended.

REFUND_DEPOSIT.title: Refund the coordination deposit on {caseNumber}
REFUND_DEPOSIT.context: The case ended for a reason that guarantees a full deposit refund. Check the amount paid and record the refund.

REFUND_CREDIT.title: Refund the credit on {caseNumber}
REFUND_CREDIT.context: The statement shows a credit due to the patient. Refund it with the deposit refund.

PATIENT_DISCHARGED.title: {caseNumber} is discharged
PATIENT_DISCHARGED.context: The pack, the follow-up plan and the final invoice are in. Confirm the return and keep in touch with the patient.

PATIENT_DEPARTED.title: The patient on {caseNumber} has left
PATIENT_DEPARTED.context: Operations confirmed the departure. Follow-up continues as planned.

FOLLOW_UP_CONTACT.title: Follow-up contact with {caseNumber}
FOLLOW_UP_CONTACT.context: A follow-up contact is booked. Hold it, then record it under Follow-up as held or missed, with a note.

REBOOK_FOLLOW_UP.title: Rebook the missed contact for {caseNumber}
REBOOK_FOLLOW_UP.context: The patient missed a follow-up contact. Agree a new time with them and ask the Consultant to book it, within one working day.

REVIEW_COMPLICATION.title: Review the complication reported on {caseNumber}
REVIEW_COMPLICATION.context: The patient reported a problem in their follow-up answers and an incident is open. Review it within 4 working hours and record what you did or advised.

CHECK_IN_D3.title: Day-3 check-in with {caseNumber}
CHECK_IN_D3.context: Call the patient to ask how they are. Record whether you reached them by 18:00 Cairo time on the day.

CHECK_IN_D14.title: Day-14 check-in with {caseNumber}
CHECK_IN_D14.context: Call the patient to ask how they are. Record whether you reached them by 18:00 Cairo time on the day.

CHECK_IN_D30.title: Day-30 check-in with {caseNumber}
CHECK_IN_D30.context: Call the patient to ask how they are. Record whether you reached them by 18:00 Cairo time on the day.

COMPLICATION_REPORTED.title: A complication was reported on {caseNumber}
COMPLICATION_REPORTED.context: The patient reported a problem in their follow-up answers. An incident is open and the Consultant is asked to review it.

UNDECLARED_FACILITY.title: Declare your relationship with {facility}
UNDECLARED_FACILITY.context: {caseNumber} was reserved at {facility}, which is not in your affiliation declaration. The reservation stands. Add the facility to your declaration on your Virtual Clinic.

FACILITY_PACKAGES_SUSPENDED.title: Packages suspended at {facility}
FACILITY_PACKAGES_SUSPENDED.context: {caseNumber} brought the settled bills with an unapproved extra at {facility} in {quarter} to {count}. Its packages price no new proposal line until a Finance Manager lifts the suspension after a review.

AFFILIATION_FINDING.title: Compliance finding on {consultant}'s affiliation declaration
AFFILIATION_FINDING.context: Compliance recorded a finding on the declaration. Read it in Control Center › Compliance and follow it up through the usual governance. The Consultant can still receive cases.

assignConsultant.title: Assign a Consultant
assignConsultant.hint: Confirm or correct the care area, then choose a named Consultant. Only available Consultants with current credentials who match the area are listed.
assignConsultant.unset: The patient didn’t choose a care area. Pick one from their description.
assignConsultant.seeConsultants: See Consultants for {area} in the Control Center
assignConsultant.askLead: Ask your coordinator lead to add or approve a Consultant for {area}.

travelPlan.title: Travel and arrival
